facts: supplied H labels;not a human oracle
write_unit: One inserted/deleted membership in explicit candidate or published result table. Includes intake,paid candidate deltas and final publication. Excludes SQL index/cache/metadata writes,bytes,IO,CPU and transactions themselves.
event_intake: If exact candidate intake delta cannot fit,metadata/version advance but candidate/published tables remain untouched and event refuses.
protected: Fee reserve if initially affordable. WCR/WQCR also preserve joint reserve only when both reserves fit after intake. Otherwise common immediate worst-write/fee guards apply;no completion guarantee.
publication: Exact margins+current version+both budgets;refusal retains old physical published table but current-epoch read returns unavailable.
